# The Global Grid

The Global Grid is a digital newspaper aggregating world, business, technology, science, and cultural news. It provides a premium, responsive reading experience modeled after classic broadsheet newspapers.

## Tech Stack
- Framework: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19
- Language: TypeScript
- Styling: Tailwind CSS 4, Framer Motion
- Database/ORM: Designed to support a PostgreSQL/CMS layer
- Auth: NextAuth.js (Google OAuth & Custom JWT)
- Deployment: Vercel

## Main Sections & Routes
- `/`: Front page aggregating top stories across all categories
- `/section/world`: World news and international affairs
- `/section/business`: Markets, economy, and corporate news
- `/section/technology`: Tech industry, startups, and AI developments
- `/section/science`: Scientific discoveries and research
- `/section/culture`: Arts, entertainment, and lifestyle
- `/article/[slug]`: Individual article pages
- `/search`: Search interface for finding articles
- `/archive`: Historical editions and past coverage
- `/reading-list`: User's saved articles for later reading
- `/games`: Interactive puzzles and games (e.g., crosswords, sudoku)
